# Command reference

[api](#api-get) · [auth](#auth-status) · [config](#config-path) · [doctor](#doctor) · [feed](#feed-detonation) · [hash](#hash-show) · [home](#home) · [hunting](#hunting-yara-list) · [profile](#profile-list) · [quick-scan](#quick-scan-scanners) · [quota](#quota) · [report](#report-show) · [search](#search-terms) · [setup](#setup) · [submit](#submit-file) · [system](#system-environments)

Investigate Hybrid Analysis with bounded reads and guarded sandbox submissions; quick scans transmit supplied data without write gates.
Run each command with `--help` for required selectors, defaults and examples.

Read/write classifies API effects, including guarded downloads and consuming GETs.
`report file` is read for normal report types and write for bin, dropped-files and memory.
Quick scans are read exceptions that transmit the supplied sample or URL without write gates, including under read-only policy.
`setup hooks` writes local agent configuration only and requires an explicit request.
API writes require a file profile's allowWrites and exact operation allowlist, preview, --execute and the exact preview --confirm string.
HYBRID_AXI_READ_ONLY=true overrides all API write policies.
Never replay an ambiguous outcome; reconcile the audit ID, private journal and known result IDs.
Downloads require an explicit new output path; save upstream bytes unchanged, never extract or execute.
Gzip/ZIP delivery does not guarantee password protection.

| Command | Effect | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `hybrid-axi api get` | read | Reviewed JSON GET only: same decoders, redaction, fields and bounds as named reads; rejects binary, mixed-effect, consuming, refresh and unbound routes |
| `hybrid-axi auth status` | read | Verify local SecretRef availability and file protections without HTTP |
| `hybrid-axi config path` | read | Show selected config and platform state paths without reading files |
| `hybrid-axi doctor` | read | Verify credentials, key level, quota and one read per system/report/search/feed/hash group; each probe uses API quota; denied operations are permission-denied |
| `hybrid-axi feed abuse` | read | Read one page of qualified-removal hashes |
| `hybrid-axi feed detonation` | read | Read the most recent report feed, capped upstream at 250 |
| `hybrid-axi feed latest` | read | Deprecated latest feed, at most 250 reports from 24h; use feed detonation for the current feed |
| `hybrid-axi feed quick-scan` | read | Read the most recent successful quick scans, capped upstream at 2500 |
| `hybrid-axi hash file` | write | Save one guarded sample unchanged to a new private file, bounded at 250 MiB. Live-malware warning: this artifact may contain executable malware. Save only; do not extract or execute. The spec documents gzip/ZIP delivery without promising password protection. Protection is unverified; bytes are saved exactly as provided. |

| `hybrid-axi hunting matches` | write | Experimental Labs: account-wide, irreversible consumption across all rules; every returned undelivered match for the account is marked delivered, subject to count and timestamp. No rule selector; preview sends no request; never automatically replayed |

## api get

Effect: **read**.

Reviewed JSON GET only: same decoders, redaction, fields and bounds as named reads; rejects binary, mixed-effect, consuming, refresh and unbound routes

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--help` | Show help; default false |
| `--config` | Config path; default platform config |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default profile precedence |
| `--fields` | Comma-separated response fields; default compact fields |
| `--full` | All fields and untruncated text; default false |
| `--limit` | Local row limit; default 100; --full does not change it |
| `--labs` | Select experimental Labs API; default stable |

```sh
hybrid-axi api get report/<id>/summary
hybrid-axi api get 'report/<id>/memory-dump/extracted-strings?filename=<name>'
hybrid-axi api get sample/<sha256>/overview --labs
```

## hash file

Effect: **write**.

Save one guarded sample unchanged to a new private file, bounded at 250 MiB. Live-malware warning: this artifact may contain executable malware. Save only; do not extract or execute. The spec documents gzip/ZIP delivery without promising password protection. Protection is unverified; bytes are saved exactly as provided.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--help` | Show help; default false |
| `--config` | Config path; default platform config |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default profile precedence |
| `--output` | Required new file in an existing directory; never stdout or overwrite |
| `--execute` | Execute once after exact confirmation; default preview only |
| `--dry-run` | Preview only; mutually exclusive with --execute |
| `--confirm` | Exact confirmation string from the preview, binding profile, ID, type and destination |

```sh
hybrid-axi hash file <sha256> --output sample.gz
hybrid-axi hash file <sha256> --output sample.gz --execute --confirm '<exact preview confirmation>'
```

Effect: **read/write**.

Save one artifact unchanged to a new private file, bounded at 250 MiB; bin, dropped-files and memory require write scope, --execute and exact --confirm. Memory and legacy report formats use the deprecated generic route. Live-malware warning: this artifact may contain executable malware. Save only; do not extract or execute. The spec documents gzip/ZIP delivery without promising password protection. Protection is unverified; bytes are saved exactly as provided.

| Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--help` | Show help; default false |
| `--config` | Config path; default platform config |
| `--profile` | Profile name; default profile precedence |
| `--type` | Required single type: crt, pcap, json, memory-strings, xml, html, pdf, maec, stix, misp, misp-json, openioc, bin, dropped-files, memory |
| `--output` | Required new file in an existing directory; never stdout or overwrite |
| `--execute` | Execute once after exact confirmation; default preview only |
| `--dry-run` | Preview only; mutually exclusive with --execute |
| `--confirm` | Exact confirmation string from the preview, binding profile, ID, type and destination |

```sh
hybrid-axi report file <id> --type json --output report.json
hybrid-axi report file <id> --type pcap --output capture.gz
```
